taskId.description: Parent compound task ID for tracking overall progress

subTaskCount.description: Total number of sub-tasks created (one per item in the request)

statusUrl.description: Relative URL to poll the parent task status

CompoundTaskCreatedResult.description: Returned when a compound (parallel) task is accepted. Contains initial status for all sub-tasks.

taskId.description: Unique identifier for this sub-task (can be polled individually)

index.description: Zero-based position of this sub-task within the compound

progress.description: Completion percentage (0–100) or null if not yet started

computeMs.description: Actual compute time in milliseconds (null until completed)

error.description: Error message if sub-task failed, null otherwise

downloadFormats.description: Available output format keys (e.g. ['glb', 'stpz']) for downloading results

SubTaskSummary.description: Status summary for one sub-task within a compound (parallel) task

TaskStatus.description: Task lifecycle state: waiting (pending dependencies), queued (in queue), processing (actively computing), completed (result available), failed (error occurred), cancelled (user-cancelled), expired (result TTL exceeded)

ModelListResponse.description: Success envelope containing the list of available models

models.description: Available model slugs that can be used with the /models/{name} endpoints

ModelList.description: List of all available parametric models

ModelBatchDefinitionsResponse.description: Success envelope containing multiple model definitions

definitions.description: Model definitions keyed by slug. Each contains parameter schemas and defaults.

ModelBatchDefinitions.description: Definitions for multiple models in a single response

name.description: Model slug used in API paths (e.g. 'dragon-cup')

displayName.description: Human-friendly model name for UI display

description.description: What this model creates and its key characteristics

params.description: All accepted parameters with types, descriptions, and defaults

ModelDefinition.description: Full definition of a parametric model including all parameters and their constraints

name.description: Parameter name as used in the request body

type.description: Expected data type for this parameter

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this parameter controls

default.description: Default value used when the parameter is omitted

items.description: Element type descriptor (only present for array parameters)

ModelParamDefinition.description: Schema definition for a single model parameter

ModelParamApiType.description: Data type of a model parameter: 'number' (float), 'integer' (whole number), 'boolean' (true/false), 'array' (list of values)

ModelDefinitionResponse.description: Success envelope containing a single model's definition

ConfirmResponse.description: Success envelope confirming a file upload was verified

bytes.description: Actual file size in bytes as stored on the server

contentType.description: MIME type of the confirmed file

ConfirmResult.description: Returned after a file upload is verified. The file is now ready to be used in CAD operations.

UploadResponse.description: Success envelope containing the pre-signed upload URL and file metadata

fileId.description: Assigned file identifier - use this to reference the file in subsequent API calls

uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to PUT the raw file bytes to. Send the file content with Content-Type and Content-Length headers matching the request.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the upload URL expires. You must complete the PUT within this window.

maxBytes.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes for this upload. Determined by your plan tier.

UploadResult.description: Response after requesting a file upload. Contains the pre-signed URL to PUT your file to.

FileListResponse.description: Success envelope containing a paginated file list

FileList.description: Paginated list of uploaded files with total count

fileId.description: Unique file identifier used to reference this file in CAD operations

filename.description: Original filename as provided during upload request

contentType.description: MIME type of the file content

bytes.description: File size in bytes. Null while status is 'pending' (not yet uploaded).

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file content. Null if not provided during upload. Used for deduplication.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the upload was initiated

confirmedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the upload was confirmed. Null if not yet confirmed.

downloadUrl.description: Pre-signed download URL. Only present for confirmed files. Expires after 1 hour.

FileDetail.description: Full metadata for an uploaded file

FileStatus.description: File lifecycle state: 'pending' (upload URL issued, awaiting PUT), 'confirmed' (upload verified and file is usable), 'expired' (upload URL expired before completion)

FileDetailResponse.description: Success envelope containing a single file's metadata

DeleteResult.description: Confirmation that a resource was successfully deleted

TaskList.description: Paginated list of tasks with total count

progress.description: Completion percentage (0–100) or null if progress is not tracked for this task kind

error.description: Error message when status is 'failed'. Null for all other statuses.

resultParts.description: Available result files keyed by format (e.g. 'glb', 'step'). Null until task completes.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when processing began. Null if still queued.

finishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task completed (success or failure). Null if still running.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when task results will be automatically deleted

TaskDetail.description: Complete task status including lifecycle timestamps, progress, and result metadata

TaskKind.description: Type of work: 'cad' (single operation), 'model' (parametric model), 'convert-simple'/'convert-advanced' (file conversion), 'pipeline' (sequential chain), 'compound' (parallel batch), 'tenant' (tenant-scoped)

mime.description: MIME type of the result file (e.g. 'model/gltf-binary', 'application/step')

bytes.description: Size of the result file in bytes

ResultPartMeta.description: Metadata about a single downloadable result part

TaskDetailResponse.description: Success envelope containing a single task's full details

CancelResult.description: Confirmation that a task was successfully cancelled

TaskOrCompoundResultResponse.description: Result download link for standard tasks, or a compound manifest with per-sub-task download links

TaskResultResponse.description: Success envelope containing a download link for a task result

downloadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to download the result file. Expires after 1 hour.

TaskResultDownload.description: Download information for a completed task result

CompoundResultManifestResponse.description: Success envelope containing the compound task result manifest with per-sub-task download links

CompoundResultManifest.description: Result manifest for a completed compound task

downloadUrls.description: Download URLs keyed by format (only if completed)

CompoundResultEntry.description: Status/result info for one sub-task in a compound manifest

TaskResultsResponse.description: Success envelope containing download links for all result formats

downloadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to download the result file. Expires after 1 hour.

downloads.description: Download links for all available result formats

TaskResultsDownload.description: Download information for all available result formats of a completed task

UnfoldReportErrorOutput.description: Returned when a shape/face cannot be processed by the unfold.

meshError.description: Why the flat pattern has no mesh in the decomposed-mesh or flat-meshes result, when it could not be meshed. The flat is still in every other output and, on unfold-and-nest, in the nest.

UnfoldSolidReportItemOutput.description: Sheet-metal unfold metrics for ONE solid (bend table + face roles + original->flat map). On failure, the ok:false branch still carries the partial diagnostics gathered before the failure.

flatLineStart.description: Where the bend's centre line starts on the returned flat pattern, in the flat's own frame: the middle of the bend zone, as long as bendLineLength. A sharp fold's is the edge its flanges share. Absent for a bend the layout cut, and for a 0-degree join of two coplanar panels, which draws no bend line.

flatLineEnd.description: Where the bend's centre line ends on the returned flat pattern.

flatLineMid.description: The middle of the bend's centre line on the returned flat pattern, where a bend tag stands.

direction.description: 'up' when the flanges fold towards the side the returned flat faces (+Y of its frame), 'down' when they fold away from it. A 0-degree join, which does not fold, reads 'up'.

kind.description: 'cyl' and 'cone' fold through a bend face of that surface; 'sharp' folds along a shared edge with no bend face (faceIndex -1, inner radius 0), and a 0 degree 'sharp' fold joins two coplanar panels.

UnfoldBendOutput.description: One bend: line, angle, radii (inner/outer/neutral and per-end for cones), and developed lengths.

tangentDot.description: Bend candidates (cylinder/cone) only: best |flange normal · cylinder radial| over the flanges. ~1 = tangent fold, ~0 = cutout/hole wall.

bendOutcome.description: How the fold filter classified a bend candidate: 'fold' (kept), 'cutout' (rejected - not tangent / <2 flanges), 'duplicate' (dropped - one fold per flat pair), or '' (a bend face not on the reference side, never evaluated by the filter).

UnfoldFaceEntryOutput.description: A classified source face: stable key (index + BRepGraph uid), role, and label anchors.

UnfoldPlacedOutput.description: A sub-shape laid into the flat compound, mapped back to its source face (compound order).

UnfoldSolidReportErrorOutput.description: Returned when a solid cannot be fully unfolded; carries the partial diagnostics gathered before the failure (classified faces with roles, detected thickness, warnings) so the reason can be inspected.

stock.description: The index of the stock in the options' sheets.

width.description: The sheet's width; for a strip, the length it used.

origin.description: Where the sheet's corner lies in the working space, Y up, the sheet on the XZ plane facing +Y. A STEP output turns this space to Z up.

NestingSheetEntryOutput.description: One used sheet: its stock, where it lies in the working space, and how much of it the parts fill.

box.description: The part's box on its sheet as [minX, minY, maxX, maxY].

anchor.description: A point inside the placed part's material, for a label, in the working space (Y up).

transform.description: The 4 x 4 matrix, column by column, that moves the input part to its place in the working space (Y up); a STEP output is that space turned to Z up.

NestingPlacementOutput.description: Where one copy of a part was placed.

file.description: Which uploaded file the part came from, as an index into stepFileIds; present on the nesting routes, which read parts from files.

solid.description: Which solid of the model the flat pattern was unfolded from, as its solidIndex in the unfold report; present on the unfold-and-nest route.

problem.description: Why the part cannot be nested: nullShape, notPlanar, notClosed, notPlate, unsupportedShape or invalidGeometry.

kind.description: What the part was read as: face, faces, solid, wire or wires.

depth.description: A plate's thickness; 0 for a face or a drawing.

slack.description: How far the outline's chords may stray from the true edges; added to the spacing.

NestingPartEntryOutput.description: How one part was read, and how many of its copies were placed.

reason.description: The part's problem, or tooLargeForAnySheet, noStockLeft, timeBudget or verificationFailed.

NestingLeftOutput.description: Copies of a part that were not placed, and why.

NestingRunOutput.description: How the search ran: whether the same seed gives the same layout again, and whether it was stopped or ran out of time.

NestingReportErrorOutput.description: The nesting kernel's own answer when it refuses the options or is stopped before any part was nested. No result carries it: the API fails the task with its error instead.

circle.description: The centre's x and y and the radius.

points.description: The vertices as x, y pairs, one after another.

bulges.description: One per vertex: the tangent of a quarter of the arc's angle from that vertex to the next, 0 for a straight line, positive turning counterclockwise.

NestingOutlinePolylineOutput.description: Lines and arcs from vertex to vertex.

majorAxis.description: The vector from the centre to one end of the major axis; its length is the major radius.

ratio.description: The minor radius divided by the major radius.

start.description: Where the arc starts, as the ellipse's parameter t in radians: the point center + cos(t) majorAxis + sin(t) ratio (-majorAxis y, majorAxis x), the minor axis being the major one turned a quarter counterclockwise and scaled by ratio. t is the angle from the major axis only when ratio is 1.

end.description: Where the arc ends, as the same parameter t in radians; the arc runs counterclockwise from start to end, a whole ellipse from 0 to 2 pi.

NestingOutlineEllipseOutput.description: An ellipse or an arc of one.

knots.description: The full knot vector, one more value than the control points and the degree together; the curve starts and ends at its end points.

points.description: The control points as x, y pairs, one after another.

weights.description: One weight per control point when the curve is rational; left out, every weight is 1.

DrawingReportErrorOutput.description: The drawing kernel's own answer when it refuses the plan or cannot draw. No result carries it: the API fails the task with its error instead.

UnfoldFaceReport.description: Sheet-metal unfold metrics for a single face (surface type, developability, area before/after).

UnfoldSolidReport.description: Per-solid sheet-metal unfold metrics - one entry per solid in the STEP file (each carries its solidIndex).

NestingReport.description: The layout of a nesting run: the used sheets, every placement with its transform, each part as read, what was left and why, and the totals. Every length is in the parts' units, millimetres for parts read from STEP files. Positions are in the working space, right-handed with Y up; a STEP output turns that space to Z up, a quarter turn about X. A report delivered as a result always has ok true: when the kernel refuses a run, the task fails with the kernel's reason instead.

NestingInspection.description: Each part as nesting reads it, without nesting. Every length is in the parts' units, millimetres for parts read from STEP files. A report delivered as a result always has ok true: when the kernel refuses a run, the task fails with the kernel's reason instead.

placement.description: The placement in the report this copy is.

path.description: The same cut path as SVG path data in the sheet's frame, y up: arcs and ellipses exact, splines as Bezier curves.

NestingOutlines.description: The cut paths of every placed copy in the frame of its sheet: x along the sheet's width and y along its height from the corner, as the report's placement boxes are; the 'outlines' result of a nest.

extent.description: The width and height of the DXF and SVG that hold every sheet, in millimetres.

setSheets.description: How many sheets the whole set has; given when the draw named 'onlySheets', whose report lists only the sheets it drew.

setFingerprints.description: The fingerprint of every sheet of the whole set, in the set's order; given when the draw named 'onlySheets', so an app learns which sheets of the set changed without drawing them.

DrawingSetReport.description: What was drawn: the set as a plan with every sheet written out (sending it back draws the same sheets), the space the sheets take side by side, and each sheet with its place and its report. A PDF has the sheets as pages in this order. Warnings name their sheet when there are several.

faceless.description: The parts left out of a sheet of every part because they hold no face, such as the curves an AP203 file draws its notes with, when other parts have faces.

run.description: Where the model came from and whether this inspection kept it, so that a draw of the same file can name it in 'modelFromTask'.

savedViews.description: The views the STEP file saved that a plan can name, as a drawing finds them: among the first 5000 views the drawing reads (those with a direction and an up), each name once, at the first view of it whose direction and up are not along each other, in the file's order. Empty for a file without saved views; a warning says how many views the file saved past those the drawing reads.

parts.description: Every part of the model, in the order of its number, with the name its product has on the sheets of a set.

DrawingInspection.description: The model as a drawing would read it, without drawing: how many parts it holds, its size, the plan of the first sheet with every setting resolved, the layout that plan gives, the scale each standard sheet would allow, sections the model could be cut by, the views the file saved, every part with its name, and every sheet of the plan written out, ready to edit and send to the draw route. A report delivered as a result always has ok true: when the kernel refuses a run, the task fails with the kernel's reason instead.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Scoped API key. Scopes: models, cad, convert, * (wildcard). A key without the required scope receives 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE.
